Priya (oncall): seeing a GPU attach backlog in us-west1, dozens of pods stuck at Attaching for >2m. dashboard shows host-local-io-latency spike around the same time :thinking_face:
Alisa (storage): checking nvme SMART history, devices report nominal but iowait jumps. could be background maintenance hitting a subset of hosts
Raj (sre): any recent cron or rollout that touches the ephemeral cleaner? we had one yesterday that changed cadence for small-file trims
Tom (infra): yes, we flipped a cron for cleaner from 03:00 -> 03:05 for a fw rollout window. it targeted nodes with tag `scratch-high`. maybe overlap with gpu attach attempts
Alisa (storage): i pulled a per-host log, see this pattern: backlog of tiny synchronous TRIMs -> writeback stalls -> nvme qdepth collapse. snippet:
```
[2026-03-22T03:05:12Z] cleaner: trimming 42k small extents
[2026-03-22T03:05:12Z] nvme0n1: io_wait 320ms, qdepth 2 -> throttled
[2026-03-22T03:05:14Z] kubelet: attach timeout for gpu-attach id=pod-foo
```
Priya (oncall): so cleaner overlap with attach spikes. can we pause the cleaner on nodes that are currently being used for provisioning?
eng-cleaner-bot: pausing scheduled small-file trims for `scratch-high` tag in us-west1. will re-evaluate in 15m. :white_check_mark:
Raj (sre): good. immediate mitigation: pause cleaner, increase local IOquota on the affected node pool to buy headroom for attaches. Priya can you kick the quota bump?
Priya (oncall): doing `kubectl patch nodepool us-west1-high --patch '{"spec":{"ioQuota":"2x"}}'` now. will monitor.
metrics-bot: host-local-io-latency (p50) jumped from 3ms -> 120ms at 03:05; attach-fails rose from 0->18 in 2m.
Tom (infra): rolling back the cron schedule to previous window now and adding a guard so cleaner checks `kube-provision-load` metric before starting trims. patch in flight: small-change, deploying to ops-config.
Alisa (storage): long-term we should avoid synchronous trim bursts. propose: 1) make cleaner batch TRIMs and issue them async 2) add a safe-mode when `attach_pending > 5` 3) update SMART heuristics — current firmware misclassifies some rising latency as non-fatal
Raj (sre): agree. also need a one-off remediation to reconcile devices that had transient corruption flags set but passed SMART thresholds. I'll open a repair job to re-run quick-scan on nodes that reported qdepth collapse.
Priya (oncall): attach backlog cleared after pause + quota bump. monitoring for 30m. thanks all. :relieved:
Tom (infra): filed infra ticket IR-2026-042: "Cleaner TRIM cadence caused nvme writeback stall -> GPU attach backlog" with action items and cost analysis. short note on cost tradeoff: pausing trims increases expected wear risk slightly (delaying garbage work) but keeps SLA for provisioning.
Alisa (storage): adding a small alert to the device-health runbook: if p50 io-latency >50ms AND attach_pending >10 -> auto-pause cleaner + notify oncall.
Priya (oncall): noted. will keep watch and update slack if anything regresses.
